_about: Read-only snapshot for units step 9, 2026-10-26 13:14 UTC (GETs only): the Language Arts unit record (id, title, enrolled, nbInsert, every deck key + card count; full cards for Plural Nouns and Verb Tenses) and the boys' saved Plural Nouns / Verb Tenses entries with their indexes. No other data.

cards.def: Add -s to the end of most nouns to make them plural.
cards.name: boat → boat<u>s</u>   ·   flower → flower<u>s</u>

cards.def: Add -es to nouns ending in s, ss, sh, ch, x (and sometimes o).
cards.name: gas → gas<u>es</u>   ·   dish → dish<u>es</u>   ·   box → box<u>es</u>   ·   tomato → tomato<u>es</u>

cards.def: If a noun ends in a consonant + y, change the y to i and add -es.
cards.name: baby → bab<u>ies</u>   ·   strawberry → strawberr<u>ies</u>

cards.def: If a noun ends in a vowel + y, just add -s.
cards.name: donkey → donkey<u>s</u>   ·   monkey → monkey<u>s</u>

cards.def: Some nouns change completely when they become plural (irregular).
cards.name: man → <u>men</u>   ·   tooth → <u>teeth</u>   ·   mouse → <u>mice</u>   ·   foot → <u>feet</u>   ·   child → <u>children</u>

cards.def: Some nouns don’t change at all from singular to plural.
cards.name: fish → fish   ·   deer → deer   ·   sheep → sheep

cards.def: Past tense — the action already happened.
cards.name: Aunt Corena <u>baked</u> my favorite cookies yesterday.

cards.def: Present tense — the action is happening now.
cards.name: Aunt Corena <u>bakes</u> my favorite cookies.

cards.def: Future tense — the action will happen later.
cards.name: Aunt Corena <u>will bake</u> my favorite cookies tomorrow.

cards.def: Most verbs are regular — add -ed to make the past tense.
cards.name: walk → walk<u>ed</u>   ·   open → open<u>ed</u>   ·   start → start<u>ed</u>

cards.def: Irregular verbs don’t add -ed — the word itself changes in the past tense.
cards.name: go → <u>went</u>   ·   eat → <u>ate</u>   ·   take → <u>took</u>   ·   write → <u>wrote</u>   ·   become → <u>became</u>
